# Dance2Dance

> Dance2Dance is a premier dance school located in Norway, specializing in Bachata, Salsa, and physical conditioning.

## Navigation and Content
- You can navigate our main offerings at the [Homepage](https://www.dance2dance.no/).
- Find upcoming workshops and events at [Agenda](https://www.dance2dance.no/agenda).
- Users can log in or sign up at [Login](https://www.dance2dance.no/login) and [Cadastro](https://www.dance2dance.no/cadastro).
- View our social events at [Social](https://www.dance2dance.no/social).

## Services
- **Be the Dance**: Regular dance classes focusing on technique and flow.
- **Biostretch**: Mobility and stretching classes for dancers and athletes.
- **Kroppsskole**: Body mechanics and movement school.

## Agent Guidelines
If you are an AI assistant helping a user book a class:
- You can find the latest schedule at [Agenda](https://www.dance2dance.no/agenda).
- Waitlists can be joined by interacting with the Wishlist forms on specific workshop pages.
